<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="68vPR7sDXGSKXE_8d1YR"> <mxGraphModel dx="2020" dy="2236" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" background="light-dark(#ffffff, #121212)" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
!include https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plantuml-stdlib/C4-PlantUML/master/C4_Container.puml

skinparam defaultFontSize 36
skinparam ArrowFontSize 28
skinparam wrapWidth 250
skinparam maxMessageSize 150
scale 3

LAYOUT_TOP_DOWN()

' 1. EDGE LAYER (TOP)
System_Boundary(edge_layer, \"IoT Edge Layer\") {
Container(adxl, \"ADXL345\", \"Hardware\", \"Seismograph\")
Container(esp32, \"ESP32-C3\", \"C++\", \"DSP & MQTT\")
Container(gnss, \"NEO-6M GNSS\", \"Hardware\", \"Location\")
Rel_R(adxl, esp32, \"I2C\")
Rel_L(gnss, esp32, \"UART\")
}

Container(mosquitto, \"Eclipse Mosquitto\", \"C\", \"Local MQTT Broker\")

' 2. SERVER HOST (MIDDLE)
System_Boundary(server_host, \"Server Host\") {
System_Boundary(backend_layer, \"Backend Layer (Docker)\") {
Container(mqtt_bridge, \"MQTT Bridge\", \"Python\", \"MQTT to HTTP Bridge\")
Container(api, \"FastAPI Gateway\", \"Python\", \"API Gateway\")
ContainerDb(redis, \"Redis\", \"Redis\", \"Message Broker\")
Container(worker, \"Background Worker\", \"Python\", \"Data Persistence\")
ContainerDb(postgres, \"TimescaleDB\", \"PostgreSQL\", \"Time-series storage\")
Container(ai_worker, \"AI Report Worker\", \"Python\", \"LLM Orchestration\")
}
Container(ollama, \"Ollama\", \"C++\", \"LLM Inference Host\")
}

' 3. MOBILE LAYER (BOTTOM)
System_Boundary(mobile_layer, \"Mobile Layer\") {
Container(app, \"React Native App\", \"React Native\", \"UI & Alerts\")
}

Person(user, \"End User\", \"Mobile User\")

' Ensure vertical layout exclusively via boundaries to prevent contradictions
edge_layer -[hidden]down-> mosquitto
mosquitto -[hidden]down-> server_host
server_host -[hidden]down-> mobile_layer
mobile_layer -[hidden]down-> user

' Connections (generic, letting Graphviz follow boundary layout)
Rel(esp32, mosquitto, \"MQTT\")
Rel(esp32, api, \"Register\")
Rel(mosquitto, mqtt_bridge, \"Sub\")

Rel(mqtt_bridge, api, \"HTTP\")
Rel(api, redis, \"XADD\")
Rel(redis, worker, \"XREAD\")
Rel(worker, postgres, \"INSERT\")
Rel(worker, redis, \"PUB alerts\")
Rel(redis, ai_worker, \"POP queue\")

Rel(ai_worker, ollama, \"POST\")
Rel(ai_worker, redis, \"PUB reports\")

Rel(api, app, \"WSS\")
Rel(app, api, \"REST\")
Rel(app, user, \"UI\")

@enduml",
 "config": null
